source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of radioactive tracers and their uses (PDF 150-151, printed 146-147).

blocks.text: Living organism (jandaar) ke andar radioactive isotope bilkul aam isotope jaisa hi behave karta hai. Lekin radioactive isotope ki jagah aur concentration (miqdar) us ki radiation naap kar aasani se maloom ho jati hai. Is liye radioactive isotope ek indicator (nishani) ya tracer ka kaam karta hai jis se kisi chemical ya biological process (amal) ka rasta dekha ja sakta hai. Tareeqa yeh hai ke kisi substance (maddah) mein usi qisam ke stable atoms ki jagah radioactive atoms rakh diye jayen, phir radiation detector se in 'tagged' (nishan lage) atoms ka peecha kiya jaye.

blocks.alt: Matter (maddah) ki banawat: molecule (taqreeban 10^-9 m) mein atoms (10^-10 m); atom mein nucleus (10^-15 se 10^-14 m); nucleus mein neutrons aur protons (10^-15 m); neutron ya proton mein quarks (10^-18 m se kam). Paanchon levels oopar se neeche hain aur mure hue teer har level se neeche agle tak jate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har qadam pichli cheez ke andar ka hissa hai; sizes scale (paimane) par nahi banaye gaye. Kitab molecule ka size '10° m' chhapti hai; sahi 10^-9 m hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Medical tracer aisa substance hai jis mein radioactive nuclei hon; ise body (jism) mein dala jata hai, jis tissue ki study karni ho woh ise jazb karta hai, aur bahar se detector is ka rasta dekhta hai.
Maslan pani aur khurak mein maujood hydrogen aur sodium jaise chemicals poori body mein barabar phail jate hain. Kuch doosre chemicals sirf khaas organs mein jazb hote hain.

Bohat se elements ke radioisotopes neutrons aur doosre particles barsa kar aasani se banaye ja sakte hain. Yeh aasani se milte aur saste hain, is liye medicine, agriculture (kheti), scientific research (tehqeeq) aur industry mein in ka istemal bohat barh gaya hai.

Radioisotopes se pata chalta hai ke complex (pecheeda) chemical reactions mein kya hota hai aur woh kaise aage barhte hain. Biology mein in se paudon aur janwaron ke chemical reactions ki research hui hai. Khaad (fertilizer) mein thoda sa radioactive isotope mila kar radiation detector se aasani se naapa ja sakta hai ke paude ne kitni khaad li. Is se kisan khaad ki sahi amount (miqdar) jaan lete hain.

Radiation se paida ki gayi mutations (tabdeeliyon) ke zariye chawal, chane, gandum aur kapas jaisi faslon ki behtar qismen tayyar ki gayi hain. In paudon ka structure (banawat) behtar hai, bimariyon aur keedon ke khilaf zyada mazboot hain, aur yield (paidawar) aur daane ki quality behtar hai.
